title: UN Security Council — adoption on the Haiti Gang Suppression Force mandate, a day before the force's 30 September authorisation lapses
source: EST: onu.diplomatie.gouv.fr/en/french-presidency-security-council-program-work, re-fetched direct 2026-09-15 by this event's own initial research, independently of the proposal that discovered it. The French presidency's 'Provisional Agenda of Work of the Security Council - September 2026' ('as of' 31 August 2026, published 2 September 2026) dates 'Tuesday, 29 September Adoption (A.M.) - Haiti [GSF mandate]' and, on the very next line, 'Wednesday, 30 September - Haiti GSF mandate expires'. That two-line structure dissolves the one-day discrepancy this entry was filed on: the primary dates the ADOPTION 09-29 and the EXPIRY 09-30 as separate facts, and the secondaries that appeared to contradict it do not date a vote at all - securitycouncilreport.org's September-2026 Haiti forecast (read direct 2026-09-15) names no vote date and says only that the mandate 'expires on 30 September', and aljazeera.com's 2026-09-04 report (read direct) likewise names only the 09-30 expiry. Stays estimate on three grounds that survive: the programme is captioned provisional, CONFIRMED_PREFIX in scripts/event-scan-validation.mjs carries no UN or diplomatic slot, and no draft resolution was in blue as of the check date. Checked 2026-09-15
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN 2026-09-15 by this event's own never-assessed initial research (docs/research/events/unsc-haiti-gsf-mandate-adoption-2026-09-29.md), after reading the one proposal that named this id - proposals/unsc-haiti-gsf-mandate-adoption-2026-09-29.from-unsc-middle-east-2334-2026-09-28.json, now shadowed and inert. Nothing in the proposal was contradicted; its one open question - which date the Council actually adopts on - is SETTLED in favour of 09-29 on the primary's own two-line structure (adoption 09-29, expiry 09-30) plus Council practice: across the EIGHT dated Haiti renewals since 2023 (res 2692, 2743, 2751, 2752, 2785, 2793, 2794, 2814) the adoption lands 0 to 3 days BEFORE the deadline it beats, median 1, and never on or after it. The two same-class precedents are the closest: res 2751 (2024-09-30) and res 2793 (2025-09-30) each beat a 10-02 MSS expiry by two days on an ordinary weekday. IMPACT low AND symbols [] ARE THE MEASURED FILING, not the cautious one. The only listed company with a named Haitian asset is Royal Caribbean (Labadee, north coast), and RCL has already cancelled EVERY 2026 Labadee call - last visit April 2025 - so the vote's structural channel to the tape is zero by the issuer's own decision rather than by inference. Measured across the SIX Haiti Council adoptions that do not collide with a major cruise-line print, RCL runs 0.62% median absolute close-to-close against its own 1.52% baseline (0.61x its own +/-10-session regime, 1.97% max), CCL 0.60% vs 1.85% (0.50x), SPY 0.41% vs 0.56%, WU 0.81% vs 0.98%, XLY 0.63% vs 0.87%. THE COLLISION IS THE METHOD FINDING: three of the nine Haiti adoption dates since 2023 land within a day of a major cruise print, and 2026-01-29 alone - Royal Caribbean's own Q4 report, the same day res 2814 renewed BINUH - would put RCL +18.65%, NCLH +10.25% and CCL +8.46% into any naive average. The collision is structural: Haiti's mandate deadlines cluster in late September and mid-July/late January, which are exactly CCL's Q3 and RCL's Q4/Q2 reporting windows. SUBSTANCE, not that it changes the filing: the GSF stood at 1,083 military and 16 civilian personnel as of 2026-07-08 against an authorised ceiling of 5,500 uniformed plus 50 civilian, i.e. about 20% deployed eleven months into a twelve-month mandate; the US and Panama are co-penholders; China, Pakistan and Russia abstained on res 2793 (12-0-3) over rules of engagement, funding, troop composition and oversight, and the Council has adopted every Haiti text since 2022 with no veto ever cast. The renewal passing is the base case; its duration, funding and oversight language is where the negotiation sits. The corridor matters more than the vote: 60 tracked events sit within +/-5 days and exactly three are confirmed AND high - pce-2026-09-30, ism-manufacturing-2026-10-01, jobs-2026-10-02 - with opec-plus-meeting-2026-10-04 the one adjacent that actually touches the cruise complex, through fuel.
